reconciledNote: apis[] is reconciled to the shipped 0.2.3 source (e578206, includes HUD fix 37fbc15 and later). The 'delta' block records every change from the P0 freeze (d3d8fc7). Line numbers in apis[] are from e578206; 'delta' cites both.
notes: Every leaf function exposed by the two preloads via contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld. 'name' is the dotted path the harness derives from the preload object ('zumi' root is unprefixed, 'zumiHost' root keeps its name). 'kind': invoke = ipcRenderer.invoke (Promise, async); event = ipcRenderer.on subscription (sync, returns unsubscribe fn); send = ipcRenderer.send (fire-and-forget, sync). 'handler' is the ipcMain registration site for invoke/send; 'emitter' is the main-process send site for events. 'rendererCallSites' is the number of call sites under src/renderer. 'guestOnly': the name is exposed to ONE guest webview's own bridge (the wardrobe page under Electron) and is NOT in the main renderer's rpc allow-list; tauri/gen-allowlist.mjs puts such names in GUEST_ONLY_METHODS.

added.name: ai.setMode
added.note: Persists settings.aiMode ('free'|'byok') and rebuilds the chat brain. Returns { ok:true, mode } or { ok:false, error:'forbidden'|'bad_mode' }. Not a pure read, so the sidecar rejects it with not_implemented:ai.setMode.

changed.name: brainKey.save
changed.note: confirm (=== true) is forwarded as confirmUnreachable. An unreachable key test no longer stores the key without it; the handler returns { ok:false, error:'unreachable', check:'unreachable', needsConfirm:true }. Channel and kind are unchanged.

changed.name: ai.provider
changed.note: mode is the resolved settings.aiMode ('free'|'byok'). The function's arity (0), channel and kind are unchanged.

changed.name: ai.setProvider
changed.note: opencode is a paid BYOK provider (Console credits); its retired *-free ids are rewritten by migrateOpencodeRoleModels (main.js:1939). Arity, channel and kind are unchanged.

changed: brainKey:save (handler signature adds confirm; unreachable is withheld without it)

added.note: two-choice AI setup mode; absent -> free for a new user, byok for a pinned legacy user (resolveMode)
